text: どれ…　ちょっと　みて　あげようか！

structure.jp: ちょっと　みて　あげようか！
structure.en: shall I take a little look for you?

patterns.name: 〜てあげる
patterns.explanation: あげる after a て-form verb says you do the thing as a favor for someone. みて あげよう = 'I'll look at it for you'.

patterns.name: 〜ようか
patterns.explanation: A verb ending in よう plus か is an offer: 'shall I?'. みて あげようか = 'shall I take a look for you?'.
